mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a kind of behaviour in which somebody pretends to have moral standards or opinions that they do not actually have."
Hypocrisy is a kind of behaviour in which somebody pretends to have moral standards or opinions that they do not actually have.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the Qur‟an and the Sunnah (way of life) of the Prophet."
The two things are the Qur‟an and the Sunnah (way of life) of the Prophet.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the act of informally talking about other people‟s private lives that may be unkind or not true."
Gossiping is the act of informally talking about other people‟s private lives that may be unkind or not true.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those married women who have lost their husbands to death."
Widows are those married women who have lost their husbands to death.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the best of all enjoyments of life."
A righteous wife is the best of all enjoyments of life.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the „drivers‟ through whom children are conveyed into the world."
Parents are the „drivers‟ through whom children are conveyed into the world.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a social crime whose effects may bring people and nations into chaotic situations and disrepute."
Injustice is a social crime whose effects may bring people and nations into chaotic situations and disrepute.
fib: ______ is a compassionate God who has been so kind and merciful to His creatures.
Allah is a compassionate God who has been so kind and merciful to His creatures.
______ are the drivers who safely drive their children to the world.
Mothers are the drivers who safely drive their children to the world.
______ are the most susceptible to gossiping. 6.
Women are the most susceptible to gossiping. 6.
______ is a noble and very important profession which Islam encourages because all the living creatures of Allah need food to survive.
Farming is a noble and very important profession which Islam encourages because all the living creatures of Allah need food to survive.
______ is the vicegerent of Allah on earth.
Man is the vicegerent of Allah on earth.
______ is the best quality for choosing a good wife. 5.
Religious quality is the best quality for choosing a good wife. 5.
